integrity.finite_checker: independent full-kernel uniformization plus integral dual tests, not an infinite proof

scientific_limitations: Only the unit graph metric and unnormalized symmetric counting-measure Laplacian are considered.
No claim for weighted coronas, general corona bases, normalized heat semigroups, or arbitrary function-space norms.
The underlying corona Laplacian spectral decomposition is previously known; the claimed contribution is the exact graph-metric norm and extremizer/transition/envelope analysis.
Publication-priority claims remain qualified against potentially unindexed equivalent work.
scientific_scope: The exact real graph-Lipschitz operator norm of the unit-conductance unnormalized heat semigroup on K_n corona K_1, for every integer n>=2 and all t>=0, with positive-time equality cases, onset classification, and sharp all-size envelope.
title: A sharp factor-two heat-Lipschitz envelope on complete-graph coronas
